decision_reason: Distinct, usable astronomy tool created for NASA's Kepler/K2 Guest Observer Office. NASA/STScI MAST identifies K2fov as commonly used by Kepler/K2 scientists, and a 2022 scientific survey names the package for target selection. Public user guidance and a current package distribution exist; PyPI history begins at v1.0.0 (2014-02-06), and the canonical repo exposes an MIT LICENSE. NASA metadata identifies Ames Research Center; Ames is in Moffett Field, California.

government_provenance.note: Project attribution says created for NASA's Kepler/K2 Guest Observer Office; NASA's source inventory associates it with ARC. Ames location: https://www.nasa.gov/ames-/. The NASA science page calls it a community tool, not an official NASA-owned product.

public_source.note: Canonical public repository exposes source, README, package history, and install/use guidance without credentials.

eligible_license.note: Root LICENSE is MIT; PyPI records the package as MIT and OSI-approved. PyPI shows first public package v1.0.0 on 2014-02-06 and current release v8.0.1 on 2024-12-02: https://pypi.org/project/K2fov/.

primary_evidence.note: NASA/STScI MAST says its curated software list covers tools commonly used by Kepler/K2 scientists and names K2fov. Independent scientific use: https://academic.oup.com/mnras/article/517/2/1970/6648831; PyPI provides install/use instructions and a Dec 2024 package.
